description_zh: ego 车辆从 Thornton Avenue 左转进入 Scotia Avenue，以约 5 mph 速度转弯时，与停在对面停止线处的静止 Waymo AV 发生侧擦碰撞。选取转弯车辆为 ego，测试其左转时对静止车辆的避让能力。

source_snippets: A passenger vehicle approaching from the right of the Waymo AV on eastbound Thornton Avenue made a left turn in front of the Waymo AV to head northbound on Scotia Avenue.
At approximately 5 mph, the turning passenger vehicle made contact with Waymo AV’s sensor hardware housing on the driver side rear corner fender of the stopped Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 转弯车辆（移动）与静止的 Waymo AV 碰撞，符合 opposing_leg + static_hold 模式，ego 左转 maneuver 可表达。
